label: Auslander-Buchsbaum
individual_source_evidence: Proposition 10.111.1 establishes depth(R) = pd_R(M) + depth(M) for a nonzero finite module of finite projective dimension over a Noetherian local ring. The section proves a formula; its heading is the Auslander–Buchsbaum theorem, not an independently defined object.
mathematical_editorial_decision: Retain as a theorem project candidate, not as a definition. No replacement term should be fabricated.

label: Classes
individual_source_evidence: Section 3.3 uses a formula φ(x,p) to speak informally of a class and calls a class that is not a set a proper class. It explicitly states the class is not strictly speaking a mathematical object in the Stacks set-theoretic framework. It is therefore inappropriate to publish a rigorous ZFC class-object definition without choosing an ontology.
mathematical_editorial_decision: Preserve as a context/alternative foundations candidate; independently distinguish ZFC definable classes from class-theoretic axioms (e.g., NBG) before screening.
